d:
Enjoy the classic Ide Nota Ide Aata Song from the Kannada movie Ade Kannu, featuring Dr. Rajkumar and Gayathri.
The song is sung by Dr. Rajkumar and Vani Jairam, with music composed by G. K. Venkatesh and lyrics penned by Chi. Udayashankar. Ade Kannu was directed by Chi Dattharaj and released in 1985.
Directed by: Chi. Dattaraj
Produced by: Subhadra Jawahar
Written by: Wali
Artist Name: Dr. Rajkumar, Gayathri
Music Director: G.K. Venkatesh
Cinematography: S. V. Srikanth
